page.overview:
Who is Alpha Trion?

Alpha Trion is a major character that appears in the 2024 animated movie Transformers One. He is the last surviving member of the Thirteen Primes, who exposes the truth of their demise to Orion Pax, D-16, Elita-1 and B-127.

Eons ago, Alpha Trion and his fellow Primes led Cybertron with wisdom and justice. But when their world went to war against the malevolent Quintessons, the Primes found themselves struggling to break the centuries-long stalemate. One day, their advisor, Sentinel had informed the Primes of a secret meeting taking place among the Quintesson leaders and had led them to a cave out in the wilds of Cybertron's surface. But it had turned out to be an ambush the Quintessons were waiting for the Primes who had struck a deal with the traitorous Sentinel, promising him rule over Cybertron in exchange for regular supplies of Energon. All of the Primes was felled by Sentinel including Alpha Trion, the last of them to go down. Before his downfall, he had sent out a distress beacon directed at the High Guard containing a map of their location, only for the Guard to go into hiding after witnessing Sentinel's betrayal. Sentinel upon killing them had wanted the Matrix of Leadership which was carried by Zeta Prime. He has opened Zeta's chest and took out the Matrix but it was then ripped out of his hands and had vanished. Primus had deemed Sentinel unworthy to wield the Matrix.

Despite his severe injury, Alpha Trion had survived after the ambush, but had remained in stasis-lock, unpowered and operating on absolutely minimal energy, and was presumed dead. He was abandoned and rusting beneath a pile of rocks for the next 50 cycles, waiting for someone to reactivate him. Eventually, the miners Orion Pax, D-16, B-127 and Elita-1 have discovered his message and has followed his coordinates to the Tomb of the Primes, and he eventually was found. As seeing that his spark was still active, Orion fed the inactive Prime an Energon cube he received from B-127, reactivating him.

Upon awakening, Trion reacted violently, but Orion was able to calm him and brought him up to speed. Realizing the war was over, he approaches Zeta Prime's body and mourns his loss. As he mourns Zeta Prime, he looks at Orion and the others and is shocked to see their chests open without transformation cogs, asking what happened. He expressed doubt and confusion about what they were mining when D-16 introduced them as cogless miners from Iacon, while Elita explained that they were extracting Energon from the ore since it stopped flowing.
